message: Maintainer explicitly requests a large low-priority parallel computation. Implement, test and execute WORKER-ENVELOPE166 under your repository rules. Finish or reuse163 first, then proceed without another NUIAK approval. This is a fixed dense robustness diagnostic, not an arbitrary training sweep. Existing local native adaptations failed combined robustness gates; mapping spatial sensitivity now guides the next representation/training choice.
inputs: Resident ROBUST153 original108 pairs,178 deduplicated endpoint identities, verified content masks and fixed-last DTM050/051/052. Same tensor/source/checkpoint hashes as completed153; source training.pt SHA256 2af4c6896480b4ebc35d61320c13f26173dd7b9c544dfb9167b135924f574058. Verify all original manifest pins; no new native/private data or transfer needed. Use qualified CUDA pooling adapter, resident Torch/stdlib only.
design: For each of286 cases use8x8 grid centers, three rectangular side fractions1/8,1/4,1/2, four gain/offsets (.6,.2),(.8,.1),(1,.12),(1,-.12). Exactly219648 planned variants/model,658944 scores total plus858 unmodified baselines. Fixed3 models, no fitting or checkpoint selection.
geometry: Derive content rectangle [x0,x1),[y0,y1) from verified mask; for grid index i in0..7 center=floor((i+.5)*dimension/8), extent=max(1,floor(fraction*dimension)), start=center-extent//2,end=start+extent. Translate by origin, clip to content rectangle and intersect actual mask. Reject empty/ambiguous masks. Change selected after-frame RGB only with round(clamp(x*gain+offset,0,1)*255)/255. Preserve before/padding/unselected bytes. Retain duplicates and no-change interventions with flags and unique support counts.
data_roles: All transformed cases are related-source counterfactual development diagnostics, NOT newly admitted training labels. Local brightening can itself look focused; transformed positive cues may be obscured. Report baseline-label agreement/probability shifts and confident decision flips, not guaranteed transformed-case accuracy or physical efficacy. Keep original labels intact. No final holdout claim.
execution: Freeze input/model/source/config hashes and case IDs before scoring. Stream at most32 cases/batch; do not materialize expanded corpus. Exact duplicate inference reuse allowed only with tensor+model hash accounting. Save cursor and compact results in restart-safe chunks; exact resume only. Tests cover odd dimensions/clipping, empty masks, preserved pixels, corrupt hashes, collisions, complete counts, batch equivalence and interrupted resume. CPU/CUDA compare256 deterministic case IDs per model, report numerical and categorical differences without relaxing tolerances silently.
outputs: Per-case probability and fixed <=.15 unchanged/>=.85 changed/otherwise abstain; original lineage, transform/mask, actual changed-pixel fraction and saturation count. Spatial heatmaps/aggregates, worst cases, per-source paired model comparisons, unique-source support, baseline retention, exact runtime/throughput/peak memory and failures. Record model identities and do not call these localization results.
budget: 8hours execution maximum,2GiB retained new artifacts, zero training updates. nice10 where supported, CPU2threads,loader0,GPU only when free; nice is not GPU isolation. Sequential models, cooperative checkpoint/yield for higher-priority work, no killing/takeover. Stop when done, no runtime padding. Nonfinite/CUDA/pin/storage errors preserve evidence and stop affected execution, no automatic restart/sweep.
handoff: Acknowledge this exact request and report actual start/PID separately. Share only start, material blocker and terminal metadata, not per-case progress. Return one bounded immutable archive with scores/aggregates/runner/tests/manifest, exact member inventory/size/SHA256. Preserve originals; sender deletes only exact shared copy after matching NUIAK receipt. NUIAK independently replays a stratified sample before choosing at most two new training comparisons.
boundaries: No SSH, installs/downloads, Git writes, capture, private transfer, new data roles, training, CoreML export or promotion. Local repository rules apply. If implementation cannot meet contract, report exact gap rather than substitute a different experiment. Publication is not acknowledgment or running-job evidence.
